title: Screening Criteria for Foreign Domestic Workers beyond Mandatory Health Screening
what_it_is: Screening Criteria for Foreign Domestic Workers beyond Mandatory Health Screening

sections.label: FDW health screening costs
sections.summary: The examination screens FDWs for infectious diseases like tuberculosis, HIV, syphilis and malaria, costing about $70, borne by the employer.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The examination includes screening for infectious diseases, such as tuberculosis, HIV, syphilis and malaria to ensure that the FDWs do not pose a risk to our public health.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The health screening costs about $70 and is borne by the employer.

sections.label: Blacklisted FDW work permits
sections.summary: MOM will not approve work permit applications if the FDW has been blacklisted by the Ministry for previous offences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Furthermore, MOM will not approve work permit applications if the FDW has been blacklisted by the Ministry due to previous offences.

sections.label: Penal Code vulnerable victim penalty
sections.summary: Under the Penal Code, individuals who abuse vulnerable victims face an enhanced penalty of up to two times the maximum punishment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In particular, we highlight that under the Penal Code, there is an enhanced penalty of up to two times the maximum punishment against individuals who abuse vulnerable victims.

sections.label: October measures for employer-FDW matching
sections.summary: MOM announced measures to better match employers and FDWs: free dispute resolution via CDE and FAST, more information, and greater EA ownership of matching outcomes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Which is why in October last year, MOM announced a series of measures to ensure better matches between the employers and also FDW in a way to better support the employers to finding the FDW that can fit the needs of the household – whether in terms of care-giving duty or to do the domestic work in the family.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: There were a few measures and the objective was mainly to make sure that, one, we make available free dispute resolution services for both the employers and also the FDW, through CDE and also through FAST.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The second big change that we announced in October last year was to provide more information than we currently do to help the employers and employment agency (EA) find better match in terms of the employers and also FDW.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The third one that we announced which will be phased in progressively over the next two years is to ensure that the EA also take greater ownership of the matching outcomes.
